capital_burned.finding: Arm B burned ~$260k more per seed

expected_calibration_error.interpretation: Agents poorly calibrated; trust signal is noisy

hit_rate_by_agent.assessment: SEVERE MISCALIBRATION (5.6% hit rate vs 56% stated)

calibration_analysis.critical_finding: Founder CEO's trust score directly affected continue/scale/cut decisions. With only 5.6% hit rate, weighting by CEO trust added noise, causing Arm B to lose.

root_cause_analysis.issue_1: Agents are overconfident — large gap between stated confidence and actual accuracy
root_cause_analysis.issue_2: Early-stage insufficient history — months 1-5 have < 5 resolved predictions, so trust scores are just penalty multipliers, not predictive
root_cause_analysis.issue_3: Trust-weighting on noisy signal adds noise — ECE=0.1733 means calibration noise dominates any signal; applying it to decisions backfires
root_cause_analysis.issue_4: Structural issue — business model is fundamentally broken (unprofitable in all seeds); trust system can't rescue unviable business. Margins too thin for calibration to matter.

what_this_proves.point_1: Noisy calibration can hurt decisions — equal-weighting beat trust-weighted by $260k/seed avg
what_this_proves.point_2: Calibration is not automatic — trust system present but agents poorly calibrated (ECE > 0.15)
what_this_proves.point_3: Signal-to-noise matters — high ECE means applying trust-weighted decisions makes outcomes worse
what_this_proves.point_4: Founder CEO unreliable — 5.6% hit rate on strategy predictions is nearly random

what_this_does_not_prove.point_1: Calibration can never help — only that it doesn't help with poorly-calibrated agents
what_this_does_not_prove.point_2: Trust systems are useless — trust controller well-designed; agents are the problem
what_this_does_not_prove.point_3: Business simulation is realistic — deterministic oracle with synthetic agents, not real market
what_this_does_not_prove.point_4: AgentCo can't work — only that this particular synthetic test shows negative result

preconditions_to_retry: Improve Founder CEO hit rate from 5.6% to >40%
recommendation.value_of_negative_result: Demonstrates that calibration noise can hurt decisions. 'Only reality promotes' — this reality shows calibration-weighted decisions don't improve outcomes when signal quality is poor.
